title: His clarinet style, tone and reeds then and now
summary: Handy compares his early clarinet playing, tone, reeds and vibrato with his playing today.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: What year did you say that was when you got into New Orleans? I went to New Orleans. I mean, when I got into New Orleans in 1980. Uh-huh. Yeah. But, trying to get some kind of picture of the style of clarinet you were playing then, I think Dick already asked you this. What you're playing now, the clarinet you're playing now, wasn't too much like what you were playing then? No. How was it different then?

Well, I was carrying the lead, moving on, doing more variation. I know the horn better then than I do now. See, I'm afraid to try to do anything with the horn of them, because I didn't forget to finger them or anything.
But, in them times, I knew the horn, and I knew how to carry the lead and play the melody behind it, too.
Uh-huh. Did you ever, um, you keep the same tone? I mean, I guess it's hard for you to say, listening to yourself. But, I mean, do you think the tone was more or less the same then?
Yeah, I think the tone was more or less. I think I had a little bit of tone than that diamond on clarinet when I got younger.
So, I had more control than I had now.
Did you use it? I'm sorry.
Do you think having two armors should have affected you much?
Could have affected on it, yeah, it could. See, because I play one infant here and one here. Which you've... Clarin is here, and I'm sacked it here.
Clarin is in the sun, and sacked from the left out of your mouth. Yeah, I'm sacked, and... Uh-huh.
What, uh, what kind of reeds did you use in the early days, I mean?

I had cane reeds in the days. And you use cane reeds now? No, no, no. I've been using the last reeds now for, what, eight, nine years. On the clarinet? Both. Yeah. So, that might have changed the tone slightly. What do you think? It might have, but, uh...
Did you always use that, that, uh, you use that high note vibrato when you were going into prices, you know what I mean? Sort of like a part in on that.
You always used that? I always did.
